name: The Fanboys

tenures.source: the federation's own comeback broadcast, "Back From the Dead," posted 2 July 2003, covering a card of c. 28 June 2003
tenures.note: Eliminated first from the four-way IWE World Tag Team Championship match, Steven pinned by Karma.

caption: The lowest-drawing of the four teams in the promotion's own comeback-special tag title match, eliminated first.

name: God's Justice

tenures.source: the federation's own comeback broadcast, "Back From the Dead," posted 2 July 2003, covering a card of c. 28 June 2003
tenures.note: Billed mid-match as the promotion's own former IWE World Tag Team Champions; eliminated second from the four-way title match by Enemies of the State.

caption: Announced mid-match as the promotion's own former IWE World Tag Team Champions, God's Justice fell to Enemies of the State for the four-way title match's second elimination.

name: Team Scrapyards

tenures.source: the federation's own comeback broadcast, "Back From the Dead," posted 2 July 2003, covering a card of c. 28 June 2003
tenures.note: Eliminated the Fanboys, then fell to Enemies of the State in the final elimination of the four-way IWE World Tag Team Championship match.

caption: Team Scrapyards eliminated the Fanboys before falling to a chairshot-assisted Shooting Star Press in the four-way title match's final elimination.

name: Enemies of the State

tenures.source: the federation's own comeback broadcast, "Back From the Dead," posted 2 July 2003, covering a card of c. 28 June 2003
tenures.note: Won the newly reinstated IWE World Tag Team Championship in a four-way elimination match, then interfered in the main event on Brian Floyd's payroll before betraying him too.

caption: Enemies of the State won the newly reinstated IWE World Tag Team Championship, then sold their services to Brian Floyd for the main event only to betray him as well.
